name: every-field
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: What is filled. variables.md: a variable is written $name and filled from the answer when the document is assembled. domain-model.md: owner may contain $name, a run item may contain $name. steps.md: env values may use $name. The values use the ACME example.

name: left-alone
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: What is left alone. domain-model.md: escalation is a list of variable names. steps.md: a check env is a variable name, and env names are uppercase. 0030: variables stay in the plan, and the declarations and source are not resolved.

name: value-kinds
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Text from a value. domain-model.md: a Value is Text, Flag, List, or Deferred, and a Flag is written true or false, lowercase. Text is filled as held, with its spaces and line breaks.

name: list-in-prose
source: Hand-written. variables.md: a command joins with spaces in prose. Person section: lines appear joined with a comma and the word then in a sentence. The people and the ACME example text come from acme.md and acme.obk.yaml, which use the same ordering.

name: command-in-run
source: Hand-written. steps.md: a command variable is written [$name] in run and expands to its arguments. variables.md: a command expands as a list inside run. ACME example, clone-and-run-tests: run: [$test_command].

name: dollar-signs
source: Hand-written. variables.md, Dollar signs: $$5 renders $5 and $$STAGING_API_TOKEN renders $STAGING_API_TOKEN. A name is [a-z][a-z0-9_]* and ends at the first other character. A $ followed by anything else is left to the validators. The rest follows from reading left to right.

name: undeclared
source: Hand-written. variables.md, Scope: a section uses only the variables it declares, and a $name it does not declare is a lint error even when a plan variable has that name. Decided by the contract: the resolver leaves it as written and reports nothing.

name: own-scope
source: Hand-written. 0030, Answers are scoped: filling reads one scope, a variable takes its own section's value, then that section's default. The plan's answers and another section's are not read.

name: defaults
source: Hand-written. 0030: a variable takes its own section's value, then that section's default. 0035: unanswered is nothing, empty text, or an empty list, and a settled answer has at least one character or non-empty item. A flag is always settled.

name: deferred
source: Hand-written. 0035: a deferred answer becomes a gap when the document is assembled, and the Text word deferred is a plain string. variables.md, Deferred answers: renders as a visible gap. Decided by the contract: a deferred answer is not replaced by a default, and a deferred default is a gap.

name: unanswered
source: Hand-written. 0025, properties: every variable is resolved or reported as a gap. 0035: an unanswered question has nothing stored, empty text, or an empty list. The zero Answers value.

name: onboarding
source: Hand-written. variables.md, Phase: the plan does not hold an onboarding answer, and the assembled document shows a blank, <name>. ACME example: account_name shows as <account_name>. Decided by the contract: a stored answer, a default, and a deferred answer still follow the general rules.

name: gap-report
source: Hand-written. glossary, Gap: a value not known yet. Decided by the contract: a variable is reported once, when its marker is written, in the order of the section's variables.

name: single-pass
source: Hand-written. variables.md: $$ renders $. Decided by the contract: filling is one pass over the section, so an answer or default that holds $b or $$b is written as held.

name: nothing-to-fill
source: Hand-written. 0030: nothing resolved is stored, and a section with no variable in its text comes back as it was. components.md: the resolver reads the section and the answers and returns a changed copy of the section content only.
